NEUVILLETTE_KEYWORD_SOURCEWATERDROPLET.d: You can hold up to 6. Some cards consume [gold]Sourcewater Droplets[/gold] to trigger additional effects.
NEUVILLETTE_KEYWORD_SURGE.title: Surge
NEUVILLETTE_KEYWORD_SURGE.description: Heal HP. At the end of combat, lose the same amount of HP, but not below [blue]50%[/blue] of Max HP.
NEUVILLETTE_KEYWORD_SUBMIT.title: Submit
NEUVILLETTE_KEYWORD_SUBMIT.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the card and gain [gold]Oratrice[/gold] based on its cost (10 at 0 cost, plus 10 for each additional cost). At 100 [gold]Oratrice[/gold], clear it and add 1 [gold]Final Judgment[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_KEYWORD_AGILITY.title: Agility
NEUVILLETTE_KEYWORD_AGILITY.description: The next Skill you play that gains [gold]Block[/gold] gains additional [gold]Block[/gold].
